From August 1, 2024 to June 30, 2026 I rented the house at ⟦street address|906 Larkspur Hollow, Austin, Texas 78745⟧ from the Defendant. We paid a security deposit of $1,950.00 (receipt #00418, Ex. A).

I moved out on June 30, 2026, returned both keys and the garage remote, and gave the Defendant my forwarding address in writing by certified mail on July 2, 2026 (USPS tracking 9407 1118 9956 2041 7730 18, delivered July 6, Ex. C). ⟦name|Jasper⟧ also texted him the forwarding address on July 3.

D) already noted the stained carpet in bedroom 2, and the house was professionally cleaned on June 29 (Spotless ATX invoice INV-22917, $285.00, Ex. E).

I am the above named person and I have worked as a dispenser at Lister & Daughters Pharmacy, 42 Churchgate, Leicester for about four years. I usually work Monday to Friday 9am till 5.30pm alongside the pharmacist, ⟦name|Mehmet ARSLAN⟧, and a counter assistant, ⟦name|Kerry-Ann⟧.

On Saturday 13th September 2026 I was covering a shift. At about 4.50pm a man I know as "⟦name|DAZZA⟧" came into the shop. I do not know his real name. He has been coming in for around a year to collect a methadone script and he always asks for ⟦name|Kerry-Ann⟧ by name. I would describe him as a white male, about 35 years old, around 5'9", skinny build, ginger stubble and a tattoo of a swallow on the left side of his neck. He was wearing a blue Leicester City home shirt with VARDY 9 on the back, grey tracksuit bottoms and black Nike Air Max trainers.

He came straight up to the counter and asked where ⟦name|Kerry-Ann⟧ was. I told him she was not in today. He said "tell her ⟦name|Dazza⟧ wants his money, she knows what it's about". He then leaned over the counter and grabbed two boxes of co-codamol 30/500 from the shelf behind me, which is the pharmacy-only shelf. I said "you can't take those" and tried to take them off him. He pushed me hard in the chest with his right hand and I fell backwards into the dispensary trolley. I hit my lower back on the handle.

⟦name|Mehmet⟧ came out from the back and shouted at him. ⟦name|DAZZA⟧ threw a carrier bag on the counter and ran out of the door towards the Haymarket. The bag had a prescription receipt in it with a mobile number written on it in biro, ⟦phone number|07700 900539⟧, and the words "ring me". I have handed the bag and receipt to the officer.

I did not give anyone permission to take the tablets, which are worth about £9.40. My back was sore that evening and I have a bruise about the size of a 50p coin, which the officer has photographed. I did not need to go to hospital.

The pharmacy has CCTV covering the counter which ⟦name|Mehmet⟧ has downloaded for the police. I would recognise ⟦name|DAZZA⟧ again if I saw him. I am willing to attend court if required.

THIS IS THE LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT (my "Primary Will") of me, ⟦name|MARGUERITE ANNE DESROCHERS-BOYLE⟧, also known as ⟦name|Peggy Boyle⟧, of the City of Kingston, in the Province of Ontario, retired schoolteacher.

1. REVOCATION
I REVOKE all wills, codicils and testamentary dispositions previously made by me, save and except my Secondary Will of even date herewith, which deals only with my shares of Boyle & Sons Marine Supply Limited.

2. APPOINTMENT OF ESTATE TRUSTEE
I APPOINT my daughter, ⟦name|SIOBHAN CLAIRE BOYLE⟧, of the City of Ottawa, to be the sole Estate Trustee and Trustee of this my Will. If she should predecease me, or fail or refuse to act, or cease to act before my estate is fully administered, I APPOINT my nephew, ⟦name|RÉMI JOSEPH DESROCHERS⟧, of the Town of Hawkesbury, to be Estate Trustee and Trustee in her place. In this Will, "my Trustee" means the trustee or trustees for the time being of my estate.

3. FUNERAL WISHES
It is my wish, without imposing any binding obligation, that my remains be cremated and that my ashes be scattered on Opinicon Lake from the dock of the cottage at ⟦street address|1186 Massassauga Road, Elgin, Ontario⟧.

4. TRANSFER OF ESTATE TO TRUSTEE
I GIVE all my property, wherever situate, including any property over which I may have a general power of appointment, to my Trustee upon the following trusts:

(a) to pay my just debts, funeral and testamentary expenses and all income and other taxes payable as a result of my death;

(b) to deliver to my granddaughter, ⟦name|TALIA ROSE BOYLE-MENSAH⟧ (born ⟦date of birth|April 9, 2013⟧), my Heintzman upright piano, and to pay to her the sum of TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS ($25,000.00), provided that if she has not attained the age of twenty-five (25) years at my death, my Trustee shall hold her share in trust and may pay to or for her benefit so much of the income and capital as my Trustee in its discretion considers advisable;

(c) to deliver to my friend and neighbour, ⟦name|Winifred "Winnie" ACHTERBERG⟧, of ⟦street address|41 Collingwood Street, Kingston, Ontario K7L 3X5⟧, my collection of first editions by Robertson Davies and Margaret Laurence, including the inscribed copy of Fifth Business, if she survives me;

(d) to transfer the proceeds of my Registered Retirement Income Fund held at Cataraqui Shores Credit Union Limited (account no. ⟦account number|0071-448293-02⟧; member no. ⟦customer id|338105⟧) to my son, ⟦name|DECLAN PATRICK BOYLE⟧, it being my intention that this paragraph confirm, and not revoke, the beneficiary designation I have made with that institution;

(e) to pay to the Kingston Humane Society (Charitable Registration No. 10794 3383 RR0001) the sum of TEN THOUSAND DOLLARS ($10,000.00) for its general purposes;

(f) to divide the residue of my estate equally between those of my children, ⟦name|SIOBHAN⟧ and ⟦name|DECLAN⟧, who survive me, provided that if either of them predeceases me leaving issue alive at my death, the share that child would have taken shall be divided among such issue in equal shares per stirpes.

5. LIFE INSURANCE
I DECLARE that the beneficiary designation made by me under Canada Life policy no. ⟦account number|LF 0499126-7⟧ in favour of my daughter ⟦name|SIOBHAN⟧ is confirmed and that the proceeds shall not form part of my estate.

6. FAMILY LAW ACT
I DECLARE that any property acquired by a beneficiary under this Will, and any income from it, shall be excluded from that beneficiary's net family property within the meaning of the Family Law Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. F.3.

7. DIGITAL ASSETS
I AUTHORIZE my Trustee to access, manage, memorialize or close my online accounts, including my email account ⟦email address|peggy.boyle1951@sympatico.ca⟧ and my Facebook and iCloud accounts. A list of accounts is kept with my lawyer, not in this Will.

8. TRUSTEE POWERS
My Trustee may make any division of my estate or set aside or pay any share or interest, either wholly or in part, in the assets forming my estate at the time of such division, and may sell, call in and convert into money any part of my estate not consisting of money at such time and in such manner as my Trustee in its discretion decides.
